about_the_game:
Shredded Faith — Forge Your Legacy in a Living MMO World

Shredded Faith is an upcoming online RPG where every skill matters. Whether you’re slaying supernatural beasts, mastering ancient spells, or building your own estate, the game blends deep active gameplay with meaningful idle progression — so your adventure continues, no matter how you play.

Why We’re Making This

For years, we’ve explored worlds that promised epic adventure, only to find the experience hollowed by endless grind, shallow idle systems, poor anti-cheat, and support that often abandoned players when they needed it most. Too often, titans of the genre have been overwhelmed by corporate greed, targeting short-term profit over the long-term enjoyment of their communities — leaving players frustrated, falsely penalized, or simply ignored.

We believe it doesn’t have to be this way.

That’s why we are building Shredded Faith: an MMO shaped by passion, not profit. A world that respects your time, rewards skill and dedication as much as idle engagement, and commits to fairness and transparency for years to come. A world built to be worth your investment — not just your wallet.

Player-First Design Philosophy

No Pay-to-Win. No Cosmetic Cash Shops. No Gimmicks.
We believe in a fair, immersive experience where progress is earned through gameplay—not purchases. Our commitment to players:

  • No pay-to-win mechanics

  • No real-money shortcuts or power boosts

  • No intrusive or immersion-breaking cosmetics

  • No loot boxes, gambling, or premium currencies

We also hold ourselves to an extremely strict definition of "pay-to-win."
Where other games blur the line, we do not:

Even a minor paid bonus — like a small XP boost — is pay-to-win in our eyes.
If it affects gameplay progression in any way, it doesn't belong here.

Membership, Free-to-Play & Monetization

We offer one simple and honest monetization option:
Membership time, available through untradeable VIP Tokens

  • VIP Tokens are account-bound: They cannot be traded or sold for in-game wealth

  • Each token grants a set amount of membership time

  • No other purchases, no cash shops, no nonsense

  • Play for free on limited availability "free worlds" until a certain level cap with certain anti-botting restrictions

Our goal is to make a great game that can support itself without compromising its values. We don’t want whales, power creep, or FOMO shops. We want a healthy, respectful relationship with our players—and we know that trust is earned, not sold.

Your Journey, Your Playstyle

Combat & Hunter: Tackle dangerous wildlife or supernatural foes for unique rewards.

Arcane & Devotion: Harness soul shards, align with gods, and unlock powerful prayers.

Gathering & Crafting: Chop, mine, fish, farm, cook, and forge — every resource fuels the world.

Player-Owned Estates: Build, upgrade, and automate your estate with workers who help your legacy grow.

The people of Armandil have awakened; the Split of Faith is underway. This era of the Old Existence Universe marks a turning point as humanity shifts from a belief in the Light to a reverence for the elements.

What lies ahead is more than the prophets ever foresaw — for beyond the Light stands the Darkness, and within its shadow, the four primal elements await discovery.

Active or AFK — Always Progressing

Whether you’ve got hours to play or just minutes to spare, Shredded Faith respects your time. Active players unlock deeper strategies, timing, and rewards, while AFK systems let you continue progressing in 10–20 minute cycles.

content_descriptors.notes: Fighting fantasy monsters in combat, some blood particles or gore can be experienced.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+), Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 6400 2.7GHz
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 3800X
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Enter Shredded Faith, a world of ancient mysteries and modern challenges. Master combat, survival, and arcane arts while exploring towns, wilderness, and dungeons. Craft gear and shape your destiny alone or with a guild. Every choice counts in this dynamic realm of adventure.
